tagline: A mountain road through the old movie country.
intro: Near Malibou Lake, this part of Mulholland Highway runs through Malibu Creek State Park between Cornell Road and Las Virgenes Road. It is a small piece of the mountain road built in the 1920s to bring Los Angeles toward the ocean.

The nearby lake and the park have both worked for Hollywood. Malibou Lake supplied the water for a scene in the 1931 Frankenstein; the former Fox Ranch in the park became the setting for M*A*S*H. The lake and its residential community are private.

moments.title: Malibou Lake
moments.text: Half a mile south of Mulholland Highway, Malibou Lake waited nearly four years after its dam was built before rain finally filled it.

moments.title: Malibu Creek State Park
moments.text: The highway crosses the old Fox Ranch, where M*A*S*H was filmed and its opening helicopters came in with the Goat Buttes behind them.
